slices.title: Run-level origin
slices.summary: Adds a closed run-origin enum (chat, schedule, trigger, api) in mp-contracts with a Go twin sharing vectors, stamps origin schedule on scheduled runs through the existing immutable metadata binding, defaults user runs to chat, and makes the FE run normalizer read it; old runs read as chat. No migration and no proto change; the thread origin CHECK is untouched.

decisions_defaults.DEC-17: One closed enum `{chat, schedule, trigger, api}` in `runs.metadata.origin`, owned by Model Plane; do not widen the six-value thread `origin` CHECK; Control `turn_origin` maps onto it; rename the other 'origin's in wire/docs.
